method: Spot list from the Surfnerd country and county/council pages (surf-reports/united-kingdom/*, surf-reports/ireland/*, surf-reports/jersey, /guernsey, /isle-of-man) and the Surf-Forecast.com country break lists (countries/United-Kingdom/breaks, countries/Ireland/breaks), plus a Wannasurf crawl (spot/Europe/UK, spot/Europe/Ireland). Facts from each Surfnerd .md page and the matched Surf-Forecast.com and Wannasurf pages (matched by name within 4 km), fetched about 1 request a second per site. Facing only from Surfnerd "Faces X"; a spot without it is dropped. Nearest sources: wave buoys from the Channel Coastal Observatory public real-time pages (position and latest time read from each station page; the CCO API needs a key and was not used), the Marine Institute ERDDAP (IWBNetwork, IWaveBNetwork), NDBC activestations.xml international partners (UK Met Office, Met Eireann, States of Jersey; live = wave height in latest_obs.txt) and EMODnet Physics platform metadata (Cefas WaveNet, Met Office and others not already listed, deduplicated within 2 km); tide gauges from the Environment Agency flood-monitoring API (England; live = latest reading on or after 2026-11-08), the Marine Institute Irish National Tide Gauge Network, CCO tide stations, and the IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility (UK and Ireland); tide predictions from the Marine Institute imiTidePrediction (Ireland and Northern Ireland spots); airports from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet GB__ASOS and IE__ASOS networks (online flag). Cefas WaveNet has no public station JSON (login for data); its buoys appear here through EMODnet. UKHO tide predictions need a subscription and are not listed. Distances are great-circle from the spot pin.
